text: A user entering a project without a behavior policy receives strict intake by default, without an implicit configuration write.

A user can change the project's strict/flexible mode through a natural-language request in any supported harness or the CLI, including before GSD initialization, and all harnesses consume that one project setting.
A user can inspect the resolved project root, effective mode and configuration source/revision; the next task intake re-reads current policy rather than relying on a stale session value.
A user can preview, apply and roll back mode changes through bounded, snapshotted transactions that preserve unrelated project settings.
A user receives an actionable diagnostic for invalid or unreadable policy instead of silently falling back to flexible or another project.
